REID SANTABARBARA
 Seattle, WA | (206) 948-2665 | reidsantabarbara@gmail.com | LinkedIn | GitHub | odyssey.stream | allium.cloud
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Full-stack application developer and co-founder of Odyssey, a pixel-streaming platform. Builds cloud platforms and
developer SDKs with TypeScript, React, Node.js, Kubernetes, and Unreal Engine.
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, C#, C++, SQL
Frameworks & Libraries: React, Vue, React Native (Expo), Next.js, Node.js, Express, Vite, Storybook, TensorFlow.js
Databases, Tools & Cloud: PostgreSQL, Supabase, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, Google Cloud Platform, CoreWeave,
Git, GitHub Actions, Unreal Engine 5, Jira
SOFTWARE ENGINEERING PROJECTS
Allium Spatial Computing Platform | TypeScript, Node.js, WebRTC (mediasoup), TensorFlow.js, Kubernetes, Google
Cloud | allium.cloud

Designed Allium, an 8-product developer platform for spatial computing (asset management, content delivery, spatial
comms, avatar SSO, multiplayer, configurator, spatial UI, and hosting), shipping 8 TypeScript SDKs on npm
(@alliumcloud) that have reached 190+ releases and ~2,700 monthly downloads.

Engineered a mediasoup-based WebRTC SDK for 3D spatial audio and video with distance-based falloff, 360°
panning, and TensorFlow.js noise suppression, letting developers add proximity voice and video to 3D spaces in a
few lines of code.

Built the Asset Manager, Real-Time Engine, and hosting CLI to automate resumable Google Cloud Storage uploads,
Kubernetes-based Unreal build pipelines, and multi-region GPU server provisioning, so developers take a project
from upload to live deployment without managing infrastructure.
Odyssey Pixel Streaming Platform | Unreal Engine 5, C++, Vue 2, React, TypeScript, CoreWeave | odyssey.stream

Developed a UE5 plugin of one-click, no-code modules for Unreal teams, letting them ship browser-based 3D
experiences without writing custom networking code.

Moved GPU workloads from virtual machines to containers on CoreWeave, enabling just-in-time stream provisioning
and per-second billing with no pre-reserved capacity.

Scaled infrastructure by up to 500 NVIDIA GPUs every 5 minutes to host McDonald's first metaverse event for 3,000+
employees, delivering end-to-end encrypted streams that passed McDonald's security reviews.
TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE
Odyssey (legal name: New Game Plus) – Seattle, WA
Co-founder & Chief Technology Officer | Jan 2025 – Present
Co-founder & Chief Executive Officer | Jan 2020 – Dec 2024

Co-founded Odyssey and led launches for enterprise clients including McDonald's, Wunderman Thompson, Dell, and
Intuit, debuting the platform at CES 2022 with Wunderman Thompson's metaverse experience, featured in Ad Age's
first interview held inside the metaverse.

Led the frontend migration from Vue 2 to React and replaced 8 external vendor services with 8 internal microservices,
removing third-party dependencies from the platform's core.

Established GitHub-based CI/CD workflows and team conventions for feature branches, ticket-linked commits, and
required pull request reviews, so every change is reviewed and traceable before release.
EDUCATION
North Seattle College – Seattle, WA
Bachelor of Applied Science (BAS) in Application Development | Major GPA: 4.0 | Expected June 2027

Relevant Coursework: Intermediate Dev 1 & 2, Database Technology, App Design & Prototyping, Artificial
Intelligence (in progress), Project Management in Software Development (in progress)

Practicum: Integrated Storybook into the NSC Dev Expo site (Expo/React) for isolated UI component development
and wrote the team's onboarding guide, working through feature branches and peer-reviewed pull requests.
University of Washington Professional & Continuing Education – Seattle, WA
Certificate in Architectural Lighting Design | 2011
